changes.title: Detect damaged statistics fact caches
changes.text: Changed text, numbers or trailing bytes in a temporary fact cache now trigger recovery from the original run logs.

changes.title: Safe fact-cache refresh
changes.text: Older fact caches rebuild once with an integrity check; original history, saved games and statistics calculations stay unchanged.

changes.title: Fact-cache corruption and migration checks
changes.text: Added regressions for text and number damage, trailing data, unchanged raw history, old-cache migration and large Unicode caches.

changes.title: Verified delivery and audit records
changes.text: Recorded TEST86's actual publication and the fact-cache failure, tests, timing and remaining audit limitations.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I found that damaged cache data could still look like valid text or numbers. The cache now checks its integrity and rebuilds from original logs when needed.
